title: Blocked-in liquid exchanger thermal relief
assumptions: Synthetic nonboiling liquid filled exchanger; all temperatures and properties are supplied for the stated relieving condition.
The heat-transfer inputs represent a conservative credible duty for this contingency. Other contingencies need separate assessment.

thermal_relief.scenario: Blocked-in cold side of a liquid-filled exchanger: both liquid isolation valves are shut while the warmer utility continues flowing. Thermal expansion is credible because the trapped liquid has no normal outlet; this calculation evaluates that contingency only, without claiming it governs all other cases.
thermal_relief.factor_basis: Synthetic oil properties at relieving conditions, with the lowest credible liquid temperature and maximum credible U and heat-transfer area for this case. Rigid fully filled volume; no heat-loss or vessel-expansion credit, reaction, inflow or phase change. Saturation temperature is supplied at the same relieving inlet pressure; the utility is cooler than this temperature. Kd=0.65 and Kw=Kc=Kv=1 are explicit preliminary effective-area assumptions, to be verified for the actual valve and low-viscosity liquid.
